title: How the Crypto Fear & Greed Index Works
summary: The Fear & Greed Index compresses several market inputs — volatility, momentum, volume and more — into a single number from 0 (extreme fear) to 100 (extreme greed).
blocks: The Fear & Greed Index compresses several market inputs — volatility, momentum, volume and more — into a single number from 0 (extreme fear) to 100 (extreme greed).
It is designed as a snapshot of crowd emotion, on the idea that markets swing between fear and greed and that extremes are worth noticing.
It describes mood, not value, and it is backward-looking by construction. Useful as one piece of context; not a forecast.
